# f5xc_external_connector (Data Source)

External Connector configuration mainly includes the following:<br>1. Tunnel connfiguration between F5 CE and external (3rd party) device<br>2. Tunnel specific parameters (IPSec, GRE)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: External Connector - Full

data "f5xc_external_connector" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_external_connector.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_external_connector.example.namespace
}
```

### Nested Schema for `connection_type_choice.ipsec.ike_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `dpd_choice` (Attributes) Dead Peer Detection (DPD) Dead Peer Detection is a method used to determine whether an IPsec peer is still active and responsive. The keep alive timer specifies the frequency of the keep alive messages being sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_type_choice--ipsec--ike_parameters--dpd_choice))
- `ike_phase1_profile` (Attributes) IKE Phase 1 Profile IKE Phase 1 profile defines mainly the encryption and authentication algorithms to be used for IKE SA (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_type_choice--ipsec--ike_parameters--ike_phase1_profile))
- `ike_phase2_profile` (Attributes) IKE Phase 2 Profile IKE Phase 2 profile defines mainly the encryption and authentication algorithms to be used for ESP SA (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_type_choice--ipsec--ike_parameters--ike_phase2_profile))
- `local_ike_id_choice` (Attributes) Local IKE ID There are cases where you will need to set the local and/or remote IKE IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_type_choice--ipsec--ike_parameters--local_ike_id_choice))
- `mode_choice` (Attributes) Mode Initiator means the CE site will actively try to bring up the tunnel to the remote end whereas responder means that the CE site will only reply to connection attempts from the remote gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_type_choice--ipsec--ike_parameters--mode_choice))
- `remote_ike_id_choice` (Attributes) Remote IKE ID There are cases where you will need to set the local and/or remote IKE IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_type_choice--ipsec--ike_parameters--remote_ike_id_choice))
